title: Cash Book- daily expenses
description:
Cash Book is a simple expense tracker to record daily income and expenses. Easily track money, manage transactions, and monitor your cash flow with this easy cashbook and money manager app.
This cashbook app works as a digital cash book, ledger book, and account book to help you keep accurate financial records. Whether you want to manage personal spending or business transactions, Cash Book makes tracking income and expenses simple and fast.

Cash Book is designed for anyone who wants a simple expense tracker and cashbook without complicated accounting tools. Record income and expenses in seconds and always know your financial balance.
This money manager and expense tracker helps you track daily spending, monitor income, and maintain a clear record of all your financial activities.

Key Features:
📊 Simple & Easy 
A clean and user-friendly design makes this cashbook and expense tracker easy to use for everyone. Track daily expenses and income without confusion.
⚡ Quick Income & Expense Entry
Add new income or expense transactions instantly never miss an entry.
➕ Multiple Accounts
Create multiple accounts for personal use, business accounts, or different projects. Organize all your income and expense records in one place.
🔍 Smart Search
Quickly find any transaction using keywords from your notes. No more endless scrolling through your cashbook! 
✏️ Edit & Delete Transactions
Modify or remove entries anytime to keep your cash book and account book accurate.
📎 Attach Receipts
Capture and attach photos of receipts and bills directly to your entries for easy expense tracking.
📈 Detailed Financial Reports
Generate professional reports of your income and expenses and export them in PDF or Excel format for analysis or sharing.
🔒 Secure Backup & Restore
Protect your cashbook data with Google Drive backup and restore it anytime when switching devices.

Perfect For:
👤 Personal Finance
Track daily spending, income, and expenses with a simple cashbook and expense tracker.
💼 Freelancers
Monitor payments, expenses, and income with an easy money manager and account book.
🏪 Small Businesses & Shop Owners
Use this digital cash book and account book to record daily transactions and manage customer credit, and record staff advances.
Cash Book works as a daily expense tracker, cashbook ledger, account book, and simple bookkeeping app for anyone who wants to manage money easily.
Whether you need a personal expense tracker, business cash book, digital ledger, or money manager, Cash Book provides a simple and reliable way to track income and expenses.
Download Cash Book today and simplify your expense tracking and financial management.
